summary: Tested Portal de Fábrica and Despiece PUERTAS calculation features. All 17 backend tests passed. UI tests verified navigation, order creation, status changes, and order expansion functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: PUERTAS calculation correctly detects 2P (2 doors), 1P (1 door), and D/I patterns in product names/codes
Portal de Fábrica CRUD operations (create, list, update, delete orders) all working
Status changes properly update orders, delivered status sets actualDeliveryDate automatically
Dashboard stats API correctly aggregates orders by status, priority, and calculates pieces in production
PDF import is MOCKED - returns informative message but does not process PDF content
seed_data_creation: Test orders created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portal de Fábrica fully functional. FÁBRICA sidebar button visible for admin/gerente/director comercial users. All CRUD operations working. Despiece PUERTAS calculation correctly detects door patterns (2P, 1P, D/I). PDF import is MOCKED and returns placeholder message.

despiece_2p_puertas.details: Furniture with 2P pattern correctly has 2 doors in despiece calculation

despiece_1p_puertas.details: Furniture with 1P pattern correctly has 1 door in despiece calculation

despiece_di_puertas.details: Furniture with D/I pattern correctly has 1 door in despiece calculation

fabrica_create_order.details: Creates order with auto-generated orderNumber (OF-YYYY-NNNN format)

fabrica_list_orders.details: Lists orders with pagination and filters (status, priority, search)

fabrica_update_order.details: Updates order details including customer name, priority, items

fabrica_delete_order.details: Deletes order and returns 404 on subsequent GET

fabrica_status_change.details: Changes order status through valid workflow (draft → confirmed → in_production → ready → delivered)

fabrica_delivery_date.details: Sets estimated delivery date with optional notes

fabrica_dashboard_stats.details: Returns byStatus, byPriority, pendingThisWeek, piecesInProduction, totalActive

fabrica_pdf_import_mocked.details: MOCKED - Returns informative message without processing PDF

fabrica_sidebar_navigation.details: FÁBRICA button visible in sidebar, navigates to Portal de Fábrica

fabrica_new_order_modal.details: Modal opens with all fields (Cliente, Código, Teléfono, Prioridad, Dirección, Muebles, Notas)

fabrica_order_expansion.details: Clicking order row expands to show items table with Código, Descripción, Dimensiones, Cantidad, Estado

fabrica_order_controls.details: Expanded order shows status dropdown, Fecha Entrega button, Ver Despiece button, Eliminar button

mocked_apis_list: POST /api/fabrica/import-pdf - PDF import con IA está MOCKED, retorna mensaje informativo
GET /api/fabrica/orders/{id}/despiece - Despiece de orden utiliza función interna, parcialmente funcional
